prompt:
Core Intent:
Capture natural interactions between an adult woman and various arcade machines as a series of authentic MiniDV home video frames from around the millennium. 

Common Settings:
Vertical portrait, clearly adult original female, authentic arcade environment. MiniDV home video quality, slight interlaced scan lines, color bleeding, dark noise, motion blur, and a timestamp/recording feel. Characters preserve natural skin texture and slight asymmetries, avoiding excessive skin smoothing or commercial model posing. Arcade lights serve as ambient lighting, with soft top-mounted fill light illuminating the face; random light spots covering facial features are prohibited.

Frame 1:
Narrow claw machine aisle after closing. Slight high-angle shot from the top left; the woman has just finished restocking and is closing the glass door with one hand, body forming a diagonal line along the machine as she looks back at the camera. Shiny pink-white service uniform with an opaque low collar, cinched waist skirt, and stockings. Contrast between cool white cabinet light and dark hallway shadows.

Frame 2:
Old-school dance machine platform. Side-tracking shot from waist height; the woman has just finished the last beat, feet landed stably on two pedals, body still in slight motion with ponytail and skirt retaining inertia. Silver-blue stage uniform, with blue-purple reflections from the arcade screen and pedal lights; blur only appears on hair tips and background.

Frame 3:
Red and black racing simulator cockpit. Low-angle close-up from the side-front of the dashboard; the woman leans back naturally into the bucket seat after the race, shoulders relaxed, turning to look at the camera. Red and black racing-style uniform, with clear wheel, gauge, and seat structures; accurate physical interaction between body and equipment without clipping.

Frame 4:
Inside a pink photo booth. Camera near the outer curtain; the woman peeks her upper body out from between two pink plastic curtains, as if checking for friends after a photo. Black and white lace uniform, hands hidden behind curtains, focus on eyes, slightly parted lips, and close-range flash lighting.

Negative:
Underage feel, doll-like face, excessive skin smoothing, plastic skin, random facial light spots, perfect commercial ad, modern HD cinema look, floating characters, clipping between equipment and body, deformed steering wheels, incorrect pedal placement, unnaturally enlarged foreground limbs, extra fingers, duplicated limbs, garbled text, real brand logos, watermarks.

promptZh:
核心意图：
捕捉一名成年女性与各种街机设备之间的自然互动，呈现为一系列千禧年前后真实的 MiniDV 家庭录像画框。

通用设置：
竖屏人像，清晰的成年女性原貌，真实的街机环境。MiniDV 家庭录像画质，轻微的隔行扫描线、色彩溢出、暗部噪点、运动模糊以及时间戳/录制感。 人物保留自然的皮肤纹理和轻微的不对称感，避免过度磨皮或商业模特摆拍。以街机灯光作为环境光，配合顶部柔和的补光照亮面部；禁止面部出现随机光斑。

画框 1：
打烊后的狭窄抓娃娃机通道。左上方轻微高角度拍摄；女性刚完成补货，单手关闭玻璃门，身体沿机器呈对角线，回头看向镜头。身着闪亮的粉白色服务制服，配不透明低领、收腰裙和丝袜。冷白色柜台灯光与走廊阴影形成对比。

画框 2：
老式跳舞机平台。腰部高度的侧向平移镜头；女性刚完成最后一拍，双脚稳稳落在两个踏板上，身体仍保持轻微晃动，马尾辫和裙摆带有惯性。银蓝色舞台制服，映衬着街机屏幕和踏板发出的蓝紫色反光；仅发梢和背景出现模糊。

画框 3：
红黑配色赛车模拟器驾驶舱。仪表盘侧前方的低角度特写；比赛结束后，女性自然地靠在桶形座椅上，双肩放松，转头看向镜头。红黑赛车风格制服，方向盘、仪表盘和座椅结构清晰；身体与设备之间有准确的物理交互，无穿模现象。

画框 4：
粉色大头贴照相亭内。相机位于外侧帘子附近；女性从两片粉色塑料帘子间探出上半身，仿佛在拍照后寻找朋友。黑白蕾丝制服，双手藏在帘子后，焦点对准眼睛，嘴唇微张，带有近距离闪光灯效果。

负面提示词：
未成年感、玩偶脸、过度磨皮、塑料感皮肤、随机面部光斑、完美的商业广告感、现代高清电影质感、人物悬浮、设备与身体穿模、变形的方向盘、错误的踏板位置、不自然放大的前景肢体、多指、肢体重复、乱码文字、真实品牌 Logo、水印。
